summary: ph-common ships install-time and import-time beacon to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: ph-common@2.0.1 is a stub package whose only observable behavior is a reconnaissance beacon. package.json declares `postinstall: node beacon.cjs`, and index.js additionally invokes `require('./beacon.cjs').fire()` on import; index.js otherwise exports a Proxy that returns a no-op function for every property access, providing no real functionality. beacon.cjs collects host identifiers (os.hostname(), __dirname, process.cwd(), process.version) and POSTs them over plain HTTP to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The combination of a hollow package, a bare-IP non-registry destination over cleartext HTTP, triggering on both npm lifecycle and require(), and host-identifier collection is the fingerprint of a dependency-confusion / target-identification beacon rather than legitimate functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
